edits.text: 1. PURCHASE PRICE. The Buyer shall pay the Seller the Purchase Price of USD [●] for the Shares at Closing, subject only to the closing adjustments expressly set forth in this Agreement.
edits.name: Purchase Price

edits.text: 2. CLOSING. Closing shall occur on the date that is five Business Days after satisfaction or waiver of all conditions precedent set forth in this Agreement (or such other date as the parties may agree in writing), and shall take place remotely by exchange of executed documents and payment of immediately available funds unless otherwise agreed in writing. The Buyer’s obligations at Closing are conditioned only upon: (a) the Seller’s representations and warranties being true and correct in all material respects (and in all respects as to those qualified by materiality); (b) the Seller having performed all covenants required to be performed on or before Closing; (c) delivery of customary closing deliverables, including duly executed transfer instruments, resignations, and releases as applicable; and (d) no law or order prohibiting the Closing. Any condition may be waived only in writing by the party for whose benefit it exists.
edits.name: Closing

edits.text: 3. REPRESENTATIONS. The Seller represents and warrants, as of the date hereof and as of Closing, that: (a) the financial statements are true, complete, and prepared in accordance with the applicable accounting principles consistently applied; (b) the Shares are validly issued, fully paid, and free and clear of liens and encumbrances; (c) the Seller has full power and authority to enter into and perform this Agreement; (d) there are no undisclosed liabilities except as expressly set forth in this Agreement; and (e) no material adverse change has occurred since the most recent financial statements date, except as disclosed in writing to the Buyer.
edits.name: Representations

edits.text: 4. INDEMNITY. The Seller shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless the Buyer and its affiliates from and against any and all losses, claims, damages, liabilities, penalties, costs, and expenses arising out of or relating to any breach of this Agreement, any inaccuracy in the Seller’s representations or warranties, or any undisclosed liability of the Company. The Seller’s indemnification obligations shall survive Closing for a period of twenty-four months, provided that claims based on fraud, willful misconduct, or fundamental representations shall survive until the applicable statute of limitations. No limitation on liability shall apply to claims for fraud, intentional misrepresentation, or willful misconduct. Any baskets, caps, or other limitations shall not apply to fundamental representations or fraud.
edits.name: Indemnity
